To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we used the support vector machine (SVM) to predict hockey game outcomes.
we developed an expert system that combines data and judgment to predict NHL game outcome.

(a) the support vector machine is useful in predicting NHL game outcome; (b) the combined data and judgments method is more accurate than either data or judgment alone; and (c) the accuracy of our system is 77.5% and this is the best reported accuracy for hockey games prediction.

the use of data and judgment to estimate hockey performance.
the use of human judgment in data mining.
a new method for combining data and judgments.
